channel.title: Sticky Windows
channel.description: Updates for Sticky Windows. Items are added by scripts/release.sh.

item.description:
Tuck handle

Windows you've parked now show a small amber handle on their top edge, above the traffic lights, while they're out: click it to tuck the window back, Option-click to release it. Turn it off in Settings → General.

Fixes

Tabs no longer disappear after the Mac sleeps and wakes. Moving a revealed window keeps its tab (releasing is now always explicit). Right-clicking a tab closes its preview before the menu opens.

Rename tabs and groups

Right-click any tab and choose Rename to give it your own name; it shows on the tab, in the fan, and in the menu, and survives relaunches. Groups can be named too, and can mix windows from different apps.

Tab groups, reworked

Drag a window toward a tab and it fans open with previews of what's inside and a big + to drop on. Group tabs fan open on hover; click a preview to reveal it, drag it out of the fan to make it its own tab, or drag it away from the edge to release it. Group tabs no longer flash or jump when windows join or leave.

Clearer first-run setup

A two-step checklist for Accessibility and Screen Recording, with live status and a one-click relaunch so live hover previews actually turn on.
